title: 皐月賞の後に・魂は同じ色

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We took on the Satsuki Sho knowing we didn't stand a chance, and unfortunately, we were right…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff… Geez, that was some tussle…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I know I'm a pipsqueak, but even if I was a giant, that woulda been a tough race.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: So this is Classic Triple Crown—the Satsuki Sho… It really is somethin' else.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hey, Trainer! That was real rough, lemme tell ya…
choice_data_list: It looks like you weren't the only one who had it rough.
It looks like you weren't the only one who had it rough.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Can't say I'm surprised. In a race this major, standin' out works against ya…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: They'll mark ya, then no matter where ya go, there they are. Still, haven't heard her complainin'…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: There's more to her than glitz 'n glam… That's for sure…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: City, you were great out there. That race really put us through the wringer.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: But that look tells me… you're not even thinkin' about backin' down. That glint in your eye… It's sparklin' brighter than your hair is.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: …That's right. People think I'm just some pretty face, but I'm more than that.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: And you're not just some runt. You may be short, but those guts of yours are on par with some of the biggest stars.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Hehe, that's right. There's more to us than meets the eye.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now I can't wait to race you again! Just thinkin' about competin' with another hot-blooded racer's got my blood boilin'!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The two nod, their gazes meeting as they regard each other with fiery determination.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: They may look nothing alike, but their souls burn the same bright hue.
